text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That's incredible! You got so many!
You were just like a claw machine pro!
choice_data_list: Take good care of it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
I'll send you a photo once I've decorated my room with it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah! I just thought of a new proverb!
Namely—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
My "pre-race plushies"!
With these little ones by my side,
I feel like I can give it even more!
